consumer: the engine's active input-dispatch loop that consumes a registered movement action (move-east) and advances a turn, as a keypress would
scope: a registered player action driven through the engine's own active input loop so it costs a turn
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_avatar — only serializes avatar scalar status getters (hp/stamina/moves/pain/etc.) into snapshot JSON; it reads and reports state, it never injects or dispatches an action
divergence: avatar standing on open ground with moves>0: invoking this surface emits the scalar snapshot but the avatar's position is unchanged and no turn is consumed, so the goal of moving one tile east is never achieved
